verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web data API that offers scraping, search and enrichment, so sticky proxy sessions are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions proxies, session identifiers or IP persistence across requests. Scrape and retry features are adjacent and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route multiple requests through the same proxy IP using a session identifier to maintain a consistent identity
